items.q:
A: What did you buy at the store?
B: I (　) a new notebook.
items.ex: What did you buy?(何を買ったの?)なので過去形の bought。

items.q: It was very cold, so I (　) a warm coat.
items.ex: 寒かったので暖かいコートを着た= wore(wear の過去形)。

items.q:
A: Is there a bank (　) here?
B: Yes, there's one next to the hospital.
items.ex: near here で「この近くに」。

items.q: My mother told me (　) my room.
items.ex: tell 人 to ～ で「人に～するように言う」。

items.q: This is the (　) interesting book in the library.
items.ex: the ～ in the library(図書館の中で一番)なので最上級 most interesting。

items.q:
A: (　) do you go to the gym?
B: Twice a week.
items.ex: 回数(週2回)を答えているので How often(どのくらいの頻度で)。

items.q: I was (　) TV when my father came home.
items.ex: was のあとに ing 形で「～していた」(過去進行形)。

items.q: Please be (　). The baby is sleeping.
items.ex: 赤ちゃんが寝ているので quiet(静かに)。

items.q:
A: Who (　) this picture?
B: My sister did.
items.ex: My sister did.(姉がかいた)と過去形で答えているので drew。

items.q:
A: Whose shoes are these?
B: They're (　).
items.ex: mine で「私のもの」。my のあとには名詞が必要です。

items.q: We should (　) water in summer.
items.ex: save water で「水を節約する」。

items.q:
A: Shall we play tennis after school?
B: (　) idea!
items.ex: Good idea!(いい考えだね!)はさそいに賛成するときの決まり文句。

items.q: My uncle is a (　). He works at a restaurant.
items.ex: レストランで働いている→ cook(料理人)。

items.q: Mike can't come to the party (　) he has a cold.
items.ex: かぜをひいている(理由)ので来られない= because。

items.q:
A: How was your weekend?
B: It was great. I (　) to the beach with my friends.
items.ex: 週末(過去)のことなので went。

items.q:
Boy: Can I borrow your dictionary?
Girl: (　) I'm using it now.
items.ex: 「今使っている」ので Sorry, you can't.(ごめん、だめなの)。

items.q:
Woman: How was the concert?
Man: (　) I want to go again.
items.ex: 「また行きたい」ので It was wonderful.(すばらしかった)。

items.q:
Girl 1: What are you going to do this weekend?
Girl 2: (　)
o: I'm going to see a movie.
items.ex: be going to でたずねられているので予定を答えます。

items.q:
Father: You look sleepy, Ken.
Boy: (　)
o: I got up at five today.
items.ex: 眠そうな理由として「今日は5時に起きた」。

items.q:
Clerk: May I help you?
Girl: (　) I'm looking for a birthday present for my mother.
items.ex: このあと探している物を言っているので Yes, please.

items.jp: あなたはふだん何時に家に帰りますか。
items.ex: What time のあとに do you、usually(ふだん)は動詞 come の前。What time do you usually come home?
items.full: What time do you usually come home?

items.jp: 私は駅に行く途中で友達に会いました。
items.ex: on my way to ～ で「～へ行く途中で」。I met my friend on my way to the station.
items.full: I met my friend on my way to the station.

items.jp: この箱を運ぶのを手伝ってくれますか。
items.ex: help 人 ～(人が～するのを手伝う)。Can you help me carry this box?
items.full: Can you help me carry this box?

items.jp: 父は毎朝7時に家を出ます。
items.ex: leave home で「家を出る」、時刻の前は at。
items.full: My father leaves home at seven every morning.

items.jp: 私たちの学校には生徒が500人います。
items.ex: There are のあとに five hundred students、最後に場所 in our school。
items.full: There are five hundred students in our school.

parts.title: 日本文付き短文の語句整序

blocks.label: [A]
blocks.title: Sakura Community Center
blocks.body:
Cooking Class for Kids
Let's make pizza together!
Date: Sunday, November 9
Time: 1:00 p.m. to 3:00 p.m.
Place: Sakura Community Center, Kitchen Room
Price: 500 yen (You can eat your pizza after the class!)
For children 8 to 12 years old. Only 15 children can join.
Please bring an apron.
Call Ms. Kato at 555-0177 by November 5.

qs.q: What will children do at the class?
qs.ex: Let's make pizza together! とあります。
Please bring an apron. とあります(500円は参加費)。

blocks.label: [B]
blocks.body:
From: Nick Brown
To: Yuta Mori
Date: March 2
Subject: Spring vacation

Hi Yuta,
My family is going to visit Japan during the spring vacation! We'll arrive in Tokyo on March 25 and stay for ten days. My father wants to see cherry blossoms, and my sister wants to go to an anime shop. Can we meet in Tokyo? I want to try real Japanese ramen with you. Also, do you know a good place to see cherry blossoms?
Your friend,
Nick

From: Yuta Mori
To: Nick Brown
Date: March 3
Subject: Welcome!

Hi Nick,
That's great news! Of course we can meet. I'll come to Tokyo by train on March 27. There's a famous ramen shop near Tokyo Station, so let's go there. For cherry blossoms, I think Ueno Park is a good place, but it is very crowded. If you want a quiet place, my town has a beautiful river with many cherry trees. You can come and visit my family!
See you soon,
Yuta

qs.q: How long will Nick's family stay in Japan?
qs.ex: stay for ten days とあります。

qs.q: What does Nick's sister want to do?
qs.ex: my sister wants to go to an anime shop とあります。

qs.q: Why does Yuta talk about his town?
o: It has a famous ramen shop.
It is a quiet place to see cherry blossoms.
qs.ex: 静かな場所なら自分の町の川に桜がたくさんあると言っています。

blocks.label: [C]
blocks.title: Hana's Photo
blocks.body:
Hana is a junior high school student in Hokkaido. She is in the photography club. Last fall, her teacher told the club about a photo contest. The theme was "My Town."
Hana thought, "My town is small. There aren't any famous places." She didn't know what to take pictures of. One Saturday morning, she walked around her town with her camera. She saw an old man selling vegetables at the station, children playing in the snow, and a cat sleeping on a bench. She took many pictures.
At home, she showed the pictures to her grandmother. Her grandmother looked at the picture of the old man and smiled. "That's Mr. Ito. He has sold vegetables there for forty years," she said. Hana decided to send that picture to the contest.
In January, Hana got a letter. Her picture won second prize! The judges wrote, "This picture shows the warm hearts of the people in the town." Hana gave a copy of the picture to Mr. Ito. He was very happy and put it on the wall of his shop.
Now Hana knows that her town has many special things. She wants to take more pictures of the people there.

qs.q: What was the theme of the photo contest?
qs.ex: The theme was "My Town." とあります。

qs.q: What did Hana do one Saturday morning?
o: She walked around her town with her camera.
She went to a famous place.
qs.ex: she walked around her town with her camera とあります。

qs.q: Who told Hana about Mr. Ito?
qs.ex: おばあさんが That's Mr. Ito. と教えてくれました。

qs.q: What did Mr. Ito do with the picture?
o: He sent it to the contest.
He sold it at the station.
He gave it to Hana's grandmother.
He put it on the wall of his shop.
qs.ex: put it on the wall of his shop とあります。

o: Her town has many special things.
qs.ex: Now Hana knows that her town has many special things. とあります。

items.ex: 出かける子どもに「6時までに帰ってね」。

lines: I'm going to the convenience store.
Can you buy some milk for me?
items.ex: 「ほかには?」→「パンもお願い」。

lines: Excuse me. Where's the bus stop?
It's over there, by the bank.
items.ex: Thank you. には You're welcome.(どういたしまして)。

lines: Wow, it's beautiful. Where did you take it?
items.ex: 写真の話の流れで「いつ行ったの?」とたずねます。

lines: Yes. I'll have the chicken curry.
items.ex: 飲み物を聞かれているので飲み物を答えます。

lines: Did you finish the science report?
Do you want to do it together?
items.ex: 「一緒にやる?」→「それは助かる」。
プレゼントをもらったときのお礼です。

lines: I'm sorry. I missed the bus.
items.ex: 「次は気をつけて」→「そうします」。

lines: You should go to bed early tonight.
items.ex: アドバイスに「うん、そうする」。

lines: Sorry, I have to help my mother.
items.ex: 「明日はどう?」→「いいよ、明日行こう」。

lines: Hi, Kevin. What are you doing?
I'm looking for my cat. She went out this morning.
I saw a cat under the car over there.
items.q: What is Kevin doing?
items.ex: I'm looking for my cat. と言っています。

lines: When is your piano recital, Sam?
items.q: When will the recital start?
items.ex: next Saturday、at two in the afternoon です。

lines: Excuse me. Do you have this T-shirt in a larger size?
items.q: What does the man want?
items.ex: in a larger size(もっと大きいサイズ)をたずねています。

lines: Mom, can I play video games?
items.q: What will the boy do first?
items.ex: お母さんが do your homework first と言っています。

lines: I'm going to Kyoto with my class next week.
That's nice. How will you go there?
By bus. It takes about four hours.
items.q: How will the girl go to Kyoto?
items.ex: By bus. と答えています。

lines: Whose bag is this? It was on the bench.
It's not mine. Maybe it's Tom's.
Then it's Mike's. His bag is blue.
items.q: Whose bag is it?
items.ex: 青いかばんなので Mike のものです。

lines: How did you get here today, Jane?
Lucky you. I walked for thirty minutes.
items.q: How did Jane come today?
items.ex: My father drove me.(父が車で送ってくれた)と言っています。

lines: What are you going to cook for dinner?
Spaghetti. Can you go and buy some tomatoes?
items.q: What will the boy buy?
items.ex: tomatoes を5つ買いに行きます。

lines: Is Mr. White your new English teacher?
Yes, and his classes are fun.
items.q: Where is Mr. White from?
items.ex: He's from New Zealand. と言っています。

lines: In the morning, I have a dance lesson. But I'm free in the afternoon.
Let's go to the museum, then.
items.q: When will they go to the museum?
items.ex: 午前はダンスのレッスンがあるので、午後に行きます。

lines: I have two brothers. My older brother is a university student in Osaka. My younger brother is seven. He loves trains.
items.q: How old is the girl's younger brother?
items.ex: My younger brother is seven. とあります。

lines: Last Sunday, I went fishing with my uncle. We got up at four in the morning. We caught ten fish, and we ate them for dinner.
items.q: What time did the boy get up last Sunday?
items.ex: We got up at four in the morning. とあります。

lines: Thank you for shopping at Green Mart. Today, all fruit is twenty percent off. The store will close at nine tonight.
items.q: What is cheaper today?
items.ex: all fruit is twenty percent off とあります。

lines: My daughter Rina likes animals. She wants a dog, but we live in an apartment. So we got a small bird last month.
items.q: What pet did Rina's family get?
items.ex: we got a small bird とあります。

lines: I like to read books. I usually read in my room before I go to bed. My favorite books are about space. I want to be a scientist.
items.q: What does the boy want to be?
items.ex: I want to be a scientist. とあります。

lines: Yesterday, it snowed a lot in my town. There was no school, so I made a snowman with my brother. It was very big.
items.q: Why was there no school yesterday?
items.ex: 雪がたくさん降ったので学校が休みになりました。

lines: Good morning, everyone. This is your teacher, Mr. Hill. Our class trip will be on Friday. Please come to school at seven thirty.
items.q: What time should the students come to school on Friday?
items.ex: come to school at seven thirty とあります。

lines: I work at a hospital. I usually start work at eight in the morning. On weekends, I enjoy playing tennis with my friends.
items.q: What does the woman do on weekends?
items.ex: On weekends, I enjoy playing tennis とあります。

lines: My family went to a hot spring last weekend. We stayed at an old hotel. The food was delicious, and the water was very hot.
items.q: Where did the boy's family stay?
items.ex: We stayed at an old hotel. とあります。

lines: I started learning Korean last year. I watch Korean dramas every evening. Next summer, I want to visit Seoul with my mother.
items.q: Who does the girl want to visit Seoul with?
items.ex: with my mother とあります。
